note: Three analyst-specified uncertainties; no demonstrated empirical independence. Proxies are indicators, NOT proof a scenario state has occurred. No probabilities.

axes.name: Digital architecture
axes.high: Portable, interoperable infrastructure becomes broadly usable
axes.low: Proprietary lock-in persists despite new public and private infrastructure
axes.high_implication: EU digital infrastructure supports contestability and genuine options
axes.low_implication: new infrastructure layers coexist with persistent dependencies
axes.high_test: Independent portability and migration measures rise
axes.low_test: Proprietary concentration and switching costs remain high

axes.name: Research-security balance
axes.high: Risk-proportionate safeguards preserve valuable research access
axes.low: Security restrictions and screening increasingly impede cooperation
axes.high_implication: collaboration and controlled openness remain compatible
axes.low_implication: research networks fragment or acquire significant compliance friction
axes.high_test: Low measured project disruption with verified risk mitigation
axes.low_test: Rising delays, exclusions or cooperation withdrawals

axes.name: Investment-to-capability conversion
axes.high: Funding commitments become accessible, durable operating capabilities
axes.low: Announced commitments remain fragmented or underused
axes.high_implication: new technology and research capacity scales beyond pilots
axes.low_implication: persistent commercialization, utilisation and scale-up bottlenecks
axes.high_test: Measured uptake, utilization and follow-on growth
